discrete_minimum_transitions.interpretation: topology-conditioned minimum state-change lower bounds, not counts of independent adaptive origins

shared_transition_localization.interpretation: no tested pair supports robust shared localization of transitions under the frozen criterion

continuous_coordinated_remodelling_negat.interpretation: no support for a universal coordinated branch-change axis across the continuous traits

synthesis: Phenotypic components repeatedly changed within the young Japanese radiation, with different transition depths and no robust shared-transition localization; the historical record is more consistent with stratified/reassembled component histories than one synchronized capitulum transformation.

fig3_use.F: A single persistent whole-organ evolutionary history is not the only historical pattern compatible with EAzami.
fig3_use.M: Historically distinct trait depths motivate testing whether conventional phenotypic modules are inherited as stable units.
fig3_use.R: EAzami does not prove genomic reconfigurability; it supplies an independent historical prediction that Fig3 must test prospectively.
